# hestiacp_web_domain (Resource)

Manages a web domain (virtual host) in HestiaCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name, e.g. `example.com`.

### Optional

- `ip` (String) Server IP address to bind the domain to. Defaults to `0.0.0.0`.
- `user` (String) HestiaCP username that owns this domain. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
